narrative_goal: Show that the share of adult unauthorized immigrants living in the U.S. for more than 10 years rose from 33% in 1995 to 66% in 2017 while the share residing 5 years or less fell from 36% to 20%.
intent_en: Compare how the shares of adult unauthorized immigrants residing in the U.S. for more than ten years versus five years or less changed between 1995 and 2017.
